The second dog cautiously enters the room, walking across the tiled floor toward the first dog. The first dog remains upside down, resting its head on the hindquarters of the second dog, who has sat down. The person's tattooed hand continues to pet both dogs, scratching their fur and sides. The dogs appear extremely comfortable and playful, with one occasionally opening its mouth wide in a yawn or happy expression. The indoor environment remains consistent throughout this phase.
